changes.text: 除了粮食，人的状况也令人担心。艰苦与风寒在队伍身上留下了痕迹，几名队员的健康和精神状况令人深感不安；一名队员的双脚在乘船途中冻伤，伤势很糟，两位医生担心必须动手术。

Beyond the food, the men's condition was also a worry. Privation and exposure had left their mark on the party, and the health and mental condition of several men were causing serious anxiety. One man's feet, frostbitten during the boat journey, were in a bad way, and the two doctors feared an operation would be necessary.

浮冰随时可能合拢。决定做出后，队长用当天余下的时间检查船、装备和物资，并与 Worsley、Wild 商量计划。在象岛坚实陆地上的最后一夜又冷又不舒服。开船前，队长乘小艇上岸，与留守并全权指挥的 Wild 作最后交代：交代万一求援失败他该怎么做，同时几乎把整个局面和行动、决定的范围都交给 Wild 自行判断，「I practically left the whole situation and scope of action and decision to his own judgment」，并告诉他把队伍托付给他，随后向众人道别。升帆解缆向东北而去时，留在岸上的人在海边站成可怜的一小群，背后是岛上冷硬的高地，脚下的海在翻涌；他们挥手，喊了三声欢呼。

The pack might close at any time. With that decision made, the leader spent the rest of the day looking over the boat, gear and stores, and discussing plans with Worsley and Wild. The last night on the solid ground of Elephant Island was cold and uncomfortable. Before casting off, the leader went ashore for a final word with Wild, who remained in full command: directions for what to do if no help came, and then, in his words, "I practically left the whole situation and scope of action and decision to his own judgment". He told Wild he trusted the party to him and said goodbye to the men. With the jib set and the painter cut, they stood away to the north-east. Those left behind made a pathetic little group on the beach, grim heights at their backs and the sea seething at their feet — but they waved and gave three hearty cheers.

dispositions.rationale: 原文为“would be necessary”，中英文原先弱化为“可能需要/might be necessary”。现中文改为“两位医生担心必须动手术”，英文改为“feared an operation would be necessary”，与证据一致；该字段其余文字未动。

evidence.quote: the two doctors feared that an operation would be necessary

dispositions.rationale: 中文补上“可怜的”，改为“在海边站成可怜的一小群”，与英文“pathetic little group”及原文一致。英文本已准确，按中英同步规则原样给出完整文字。

evidence.quote: made a pathetic little group on the beach
